run_uma_1p2_surgery: run the uma_1p2_surgery CLI to perform checkpoint surgery on a UMA 1.2 model checkpoint
add_omat_rattle_support: add omat_rattle dataset support to a FAIRChem checkpoint by cloning omat embeddings and updating config
remove_omat_rattle: remove omat_rattle from a checkpoint config and resize expert weights from 8 to 7 slots
create_test_systems: create PBC and non-PBC H2O test systems using ASE for checkpoint validation
compare_checkpoints: compare two FAIRChem checkpoints across all tasks and report energy and force differences
